Mission Local reported in September 2023 that SF State department chairs had told lecturers to expect fewer classes in spring, with some losing their classes entirely. The number of lecturers affected was unknown. The university’s budget presentation outlined cuts equivalent to 125 full-time positions, including 23 tenure-track faculty positions and six staff positions; lecturers were facing the largest cuts, estimated at about 30 percent for most colleges.

The story was published September 29, 2023: https://missionlocal.org/2023/09/san-francisco-state-university-facing-mass-staffing-cuts/

Correction: A previous version said SF State had suffered a 16 percent drop in enrollment; the school was actually 16 percent below its target enrollment.
